summary: Re-verified both backend and frontend after fixes. All 4 pytest cases pass (products=8 with required fields, match explanation contains the exact returned product name and no other catalogue name across 3 varied combos, chat returns session/reply/ok:true mentioning a catalogue item). Full desktop UI flow verified: Matchmaker returns Cinnamon Rolls with matching explanation, cart flow (add, qty+, remove, empty state) works, Build-a-box adds exactly 4 rows and cart-count=6 with cart-total==box-total (Rs. 3,500), WhatsApp handoff opens a wa.me URL, Surprise Me renders a product, Baker Chat replies within 30s and mentions a catalogue item (Coffee & Walnut Cake). Mobile layout at 400x800 hides .nav-links (display:none) and keeps the cart-pill reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend still silently swallows /api/match and /api/chat errors (matchError/chatError shown, but no user-visible retry). Non-blocking.
server.py has no unit tests for _pick_product scoring; a lightweight unit test would guard tie-break/budget logic.
CORS_ORIGINS default '*' with allow_credentials=True is a mild security smell in production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend served at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL+/api; 4 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_public_api.py serve as regression. All UI selectors used are stable data-testid values documented in App.js.
rca of the issue: Prior iteration's LLM name-drift bug is resolved: server injects the deterministic product name into the prompt AND applies a post-response safety net that rewrites the sentence if a wrong catalogue name is detected. Cart bug from iteration_1 was a test assertion timing issue; the current UI correctly increments cart-count via cartCount memo and renders cart-item-<id> rows inside the drawer.
